clauses.text: 1. Background

clauses.text: 1.1 This Contract Renewal (“Renewal”) is entered into pursuant to the Original Annual Maintenance & Support Agreement (AMSA) executed on 1 January 2025 (“Original Agreement”) between PrimeVolta Hardware Solutions, incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (“Vendor”), and FinSecure Services, a BFSI company (“Client”).

source_location.excerpt: 1.1 This Contract Renewal (“Renewal”) is entered into pursuant to the Original Annual Maintenance & Support Agreement (AMSA) executed on 1 January 2025 (“Original Agreement”) between PrimeVolta Hardware Solutions, incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (“Vendor”), and FinSecure Services, a BFSI company (“Client”).

clauses.text: 1.2 The Original Agreement governs the preventive and corrective maintenance, firmware updates, and technical support for all IoT-enabled Smart Power Modules, Secure Hardware Authentication Terminals (HATs), and Embedded Processor Boards deployed across Client branches.

source_location.excerpt: 1.2 The Original Agreement governs the preventive and corrective maintenance, firmware updates, and technical support for all IoT-enabled Smart Power Modules, Secure Hardware Authentication Terminals (HATs), and Embedded Processor Boards deployed across Client branches.

clauses.text: 1.3 This Renewal extends the Original Agreement for an additional 12-month period with updated terms, SLAs, and pricing.
